ouch.definition:
n. A socket or bezel holding a precious stone; hence, a jewel or
   ornament worn on the person.
ouch.translation:
interj. 哎唷(表剧痛)
n. 扣环, 胸针, 珠宝饰物

ouched.translation:
n. 扣环
int. 哎哟（突然疼痛时发出的声音）
n. (Ouch)人名；(柬)乌

ouches.definition:
-s form of ouch
n. A socket or bezel holding a precious stone; hence, a jewel or

ouches.translation:
(ouch 的第三人称 -s形式) interj. 哎唷(表剧痛)
n. 扣环, 胸针, 珠宝饰物

ouchy.translation: [美俚]神经过敏的, 脾气暴躁的
